subject: Clarify: On-prem packaging, ancillary fees & SLA banding for Olive Health
messages:
From: Sara Chen <sara.chen@olivehealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@olivehealth.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on on-prem packaging (appendix A)

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to follow up with a few specific things we need to include in our internal award memo so we can compare apples-to-apples across vendors. Quick list — can you confirm each and, if possible, provide a short line-itemized attachment?

- Platform fee amortization options (36/48/60 months) and suggested accounting treatment (capex vs opex).
- Operator licenses vs site/node pricing (example: 50 nodes + 5 operator seats).
- SRE on-call retainer and a proposed service-credit matrix by severity and MTTR.
- Any ancillary fees (migration support, escrow, third-party connectors) and whether you can absorb pilot/support credits.
- Can you provide an example invoice schedule for a 3-year commit?

Procurement also attached Appendix A from our RFP for context (see attached). We need this back by EOD Monday so I can include it in the vendor packet.

Best,
Sara Chen
Senior Sourcing Manager
Olive Health

Attachment: Olive_RFP_Appendix_A.pdf (pdf, 220KB)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <sara.chen@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on on-prem packaging (appendix A)

Hi Sara —

Appreciate the clear list. I pulled together a concise options one-pager for Olive that addresses each ask and shows the accounting-friendly amortization scenarios. See attached: RI_OnPrem_Pricing_Options_v1.pdf.

High-level summary here so your team can start the vendor packet:
- Platform fee: standard 12% of committed node value annually; can be amortized over 36/48/60 months with a straight-line schedule. We can show revenue recognition language to help your finance team.
- Operator seats: available as a 1:10 operator-to-node ratio or as discrete licenses (50 nodes + 5 operator seats example included).
- SRE retainer: three tiers (Standard, Priority, Platinum) with defined on-call windows and a service-credit matrix. We can provide a reduced retainer for pilots and a 30% credit on month 1 for onboarding.
- Ancillaries: migration retainer, escrow fee, and a small connector integration fee. We are open to bundling migration retainer into the first-year platform fee for pilot deals.

Next steps: can you confirm the preferred amortization term and whether procurement needs the invoice schedule in excel? If you’re available, Marissa (cc'd) and I can run through the one-pager on a 30-min call.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: RI_OnPrem_Pricing_Options_v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: Olive negotiation playbook (notes)

Chloe / Karthik —

Notes for the call / what we can concede vs require: 
- Concede: amortize platform fee over 36 months (instead of 48) for 3-year commits; offer pilot onboarding credit of 30% to be taken off first invoice.
- Concede: migrate retainer can be bundled year 1 if they commit to a minimum of 40 nodes.
- Require: operator license floor of 3 seats per site; if they ask for lower, we charge per-seat.
- Require: escalate SLA reductions only with explicit quid-pro-quo on node commit (i.e., deeper SLOs come with higher commit).
- Ask: try to secure a case study clause and a 6-month technical cooperation window to smooth knowledge transfer.

Pricing tweak for procurement packet (example 36mo amortization, 50 nodes):
- One-time onboarding & migration (bundled): $80k (30% credit applied for pilot = $56k).
- Committed nodes (50): $X per node — populate with sales guidance in call.
- Platform fee (annual, amortized): shows as $Y per year in invoice schedule; we present both gross and amortized lines so their finance can choose treatment.

I'll be on the call at 2pm PT to walk through the one-pager.

-Marissa
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <sara.chen@olivehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@olivehealth.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: On-prem packaging options + invoice schedule (per your ask)

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our call and the internal alignment, attached is a short options pack that contains:
1) Three amortization scenarios (36/48/60 months) with example invoice schedules (suitable for inclusion in procurement packet).
2) Operator license vs node pricing examples (50 nodes + 5 ops example included).
3) SRE retainer tiers and service-credit matrix that maps to severity windows.
4) Ancillary fee list and the pilot credit treatment.

High level concessions we confirmed: 36-month amortization for a 3-year commit; 30% pilot onboarding credit applied to the onboarding line item; migration retainer can be bundled into year 1 if you can confirm minimum 40-node commit.

I attached the pack and included a link to a draft DocuSign if procurement wants to accelerate. If you need the invoice schedule as a downloadable Excel, I can send that separately.

Link to one-pager: https://redwood-inference.s3/quotes/DEAL-2026-1182/one-pager.pdf
DocuSign (draft): https://docusign.com/example/DEAL-2026-1182

Ask: Can procurement confirm preferred amortization term (we recommend 36mo for capex-eligible scenarios) and whether Olive will accept the pilot credit as a deduction on month 1? Once you confirm, I’ll route the revised SOW for signatures.

Best regards,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: RI_OnPrem_Pricing_Options_v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
